main.description: What the account owner publishes about one of their tracks beyond its fm.plyr.track record: lyrics, sheet music and authorship.

track.description: The fm.plyr.track record this one describes, at the version it was written against.

kind.description: Whether the owner wrote the piece or performs someone else's.

originalArtist.description: Who the piece is by, when it is a cover.

score.description: Sheet music as MusicXML: compressed (.mxl, application/vnd.recordare.musicxml) or plain (application/vnd.recordare.musicxml+xml). A compressed score is a ZIP container, and a server that names blobs by their content reports it as application/zip.

format.description: lrc: lines carry [mm:ss.xx] timestamps. plain: untimed text.

text.description: The words, one line per sung line.
